categorisation: The gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with the process of determining ownership, possession, or interest in specific land parcels in various districts. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, which includes land registrations, title determinations, and related administrative notices. The content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized non-land categories.
